== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The original slip names IT-0. The later heading adds Eyetee-Oh and uses IT-O, while its footer still uses IT-0 with the spelled-out name. The original article and later rendition already exist. The +2 Force drain at the captive’s location, Hypo deployment and both immunities remain. The later sentence does not print the separate word present.
